finishing_script.source:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

step="$1"
name="$2"
raw="$3"
task_dir=".tmp/light-border-20260910"
old_dir=".tmp/illustration-sources/blurb-repair-2026-09-09"
work="$task_dir/work/$name"
mkdir -p "$work"

# Remove the generated magenta key, retaining its generated watercolor falloff.
# Recover coverage from the key/pigment red-green difference, then unmix only
# that key. Measured exterior key is approximately #fc05fc (not exact ff00ff).
# The prompt specifies the original light lavender, #b8bffc.
# No blur, alpha threshold, or synthetic fade is applied to the new edge.
convert "$raw" -alpha on \
  -channel A -fx 'max(0,min(1,(247/255-r+g)/(254/255)))' \
  -channel R -fx 'a>0 ? max(0,min(1,(r-(1-a)*252/255)/a)) : 0' \
  -channel G -fx 'a>0 ? max(0,min(1,(g-(1-a)*5/255)/a)) : 0' \
  -channel B -fx 'a>0 ? max(0,min(1,(b-(1-a)*252/255)/a)) : 0' \
  +channel -background none -resize 957x532 -gravity center -extent 957x532 \
  "$work/generated-cloud.png"

# These masks select what original artwork to protect. They do not create the
# watercolor perimeter: that perimeter and its falloff come from imagegen above.
convert "$old_dir/step${step}-light-candidate-cloud.png" -alpha extract \
  -threshold 5% "$work/original-cloud-area.png"
convert "$work/original-cloud-area.png" -morphology Dilate Disk:8 \
  "$work/allowed-extent.png"
for radius in 14 16 18 20 22 24 26 28; do
  convert "$work/original-cloud-area.png" -morphology Erode "Disk:$radius" \
    "$work/protected-interior-$radius.png"
done
convert "$work"/protected-interior-*.png -evaluate-sequence mean \
  "$work/protected-interior.png"
convert "$work/protected-interior.png" -negate \
  "$work/allowed-extent.png" -compose Multiply -composite \
  "$old_dir/foreground/$name-foreground-mask.png" \
  -fx 'u[1]>0 ? 0 : u[0]' "$work/border-selection.png"

# Blend only the selected border band. Foreground, interior, and outer canvas
# are taken from the current original at their exact original coordinates.
convert "$task_dir/before/$name.webp" "$work/generated-cloud.png" \
  "$work/border-selection.png" -alpha on -channel RGBA \
  -fx 'u[2].r*u[1]+(1-u[2].r)*u[0]' +channel \
  -define webp:lossless=true "$task_dir/$name.webp"
convert "$task_dir/$name.webp" -background '#f0f0fc' -alpha remove -alpha off \
  "$task_dir/$name-preview.png"
